# Bruno Moya

> I turn emerging technology into real products. AI engineer & technical founder · CTO at TopBrokers · Founder at Glassear, based in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

Software engineer and technical founder based in Barcelona. Builds agentic AI systems that run in production: CTO at TopBrokers, where LLM and messaging workflows handle over 1,000 conversations a day, and founder of Glassear, whose Studio platform turns natural language into interactive XR applications. A decade of hardware, computer vision and infrastructure underneath.

## Full profile

- [Everything as plain text](https://brunomoya.com/llms-full.txt): what he is building, milestones, awards, talks, press, experience, projects, education and skills in one file.
- [Structured professional profile](https://brunomoya.com/profile.json): the same information as JSON.

## Pages

- [Resume](https://brunomoya.com/resume/): career summary, also as [Markdown](https://brunomoya.com/resume.md) and [PDF](https://brunomoya.com/cv-english.pdf).
- [Experience](https://brunomoya.com/experience/): roles, dates, responsibilities and technologies.
- [Projects](https://brunomoya.com/projects/): selected work, also as [Markdown](https://brunomoya.com/projects.md).
- [JobAgent - Autonomous AI Job Search & Application System](https://brunomoya.com/projects/jobagent/): I use JobAgent to manage my own job search.
- [TalentGapAnalyzer - AI Workforce Intelligence](https://brunomoya.com/projects/talent-gap-analyzer/): Winner - UAB The Hack 2025
- [Glassear Studio - Natural Language to Interactive XR](https://brunomoya.com/projects/glassear-studio/): An AI-native platform for building and modifying interactive XR applications across a web authoring environment and Unity runtime.
- [MapAnim — Route Motion Studio](https://brunomoya.com/projects/mapanim/): An interactive route-animation editor combining itinerary editing, camera controls, map styling and a frame-by-frame export pipeline.

Every page above is also available as markdown. Send `Accept: text/markdown` and the
response comes back as `text/markdown`, with an `x-markdown-tokens` estimate, instead of
HTML; or append `index.md` to the URL. Spanish is at the root, English under /en/.
